purpose: Local --link-checker adapter used by the native v0.4 minor archive (minor_close.py archive --apply), with its review and real-checkout qualification.
root_cause: The official link-baseline.py diff infers directory renames from file renames. For docs/releases/v0/v0.4 -> docs/archives/v0/v0.4 it also inferred docs/releases -> docs/archives, projected the pre-existing missing target docs/releases/v0/implement-phase/references/completion-contract.md into docs/archives, and reported the unchanged target as newly broken. The first apply refused and rolled back.

adapter.method: Delegates to the unchanged official checker. Verifies a complete single-directory move against git observations (HEAD tree before, index after, same HEAD) and gives every before-baseline source and target an exact rename-map entry, so inferred prefixes never apply to baseline rows. After-baseline rows are not filtered.

qualification.replay: baseline, staged git mv of the v0.4 tree, unstaged six-file repair, R-only rename map, baseline, diff (native order)
qualification.adapter_diff: adapter-diff.json: newly_broken 0, the pre-existing missing target kept in original coordinates
qualification.official_countercontrol: official-diff.json: newly_broken 1 on the same inputs (reproduces the refusal)
countercontrols: deliberate new broken link fails (exit 1, newly_broken 1)

independent_review.inherited_official_limit: diff identity is (source, target) without link text, so a second broken link to an already broken target in the same file is not reported; present with or without the adapter
fail_closed_limits: targets of stationary files are projected too
targets outside the repository root are rejected
RuntimeError from the official rename-map parser is not caught (traceback, empty report, caller refuses)
independent_review.note: context sidecar is a consistency check, not authentication; the caller uses a private temporary directory

apply.outcome: ARCHIVED v0.4 docs/releases/v0/v0.4 -> docs/archives/v0/v0.4 commit=d6e9840 links=112 mentions=17 files=6 residual_references=49 newly_broken=0
